# ContentSwap

Swaps content in place. The new content fades in over 133ms with a 1% sideways nudge, and the container’s height animates over 300ms. Used between Ship and Pick up, and between the shipping method states.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/contentswap)

## Usage

```tsx
<ContentSwap activeKey={delivery} from={delivery === 'pickup' ? 'end' : 'start'}>
  {delivery === 'ship' ? <AddressForm … /> : <PickupLocations … />}
</ContentSwap>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `activeKey` | `string` | Identifies what is showing. A change triggers the animation. |
| `from` | `'start' \| 'end'` | Side the new content nudges in from. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The content for the current key. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `ContentSwap.module.css`
- `ContentSwap.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/hooks/useAnimatedHeight.ts`](../../hooks/useAnimatedHeight.ts)
- [`src/lib/motion.ts`](../../lib/motion.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
